_comment: Detection-engine memory per configuration, measured 2026-11-14 on Apple Silicon as macOS *physical footprint* (`footprint -p`, includes compressed pages - the closest macOS analogue of Linux RSS; plain `ps` RSS excludes compressed pages and understated full en_core_web_lg at ~340 MB vs 705 MB here). Peak sampled every 150 ms during load + detection of the gold set. Speed is per 10k characters on arm64, where onnxruntime int8 kernels are slow; x86 hosts should run the GLiNER configs faster. Re-measure on the target host with `python -m evals.run_latency`.
